title: Geologic maps of the Congaree, Eastover, Leesburg and Messers Pond 7.5 minute quadrangles
citation: Kite, L.E., 1988, Geologic maps of the Congaree, Eastover, Leesburg and Messers Pond 7.5 minute quadrangles: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-62, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Five OCR'd sheets: geologic maps of the Congaree, Eastover, Leesburg and Messers Pond quadrangles and cross section A-A' of Eastover. The explanation of map units is in a separate text not included in this record, so unit names, ages and descriptions are not available; map-face symbols (Qal, Trt, K, Tp1, Tp2, Tme, Tuu, Tss, Tu) are noted here only. 63 SCGS drill-hole labels (40-xx, 28-xx) read from the map faces on page images; no logs printed. One Congaree label near 40-134 was not legible and was not recorded. SUBSURFACE: section A-A' contacts drawn but not digitized.
